chunk_map.heading: Where the team sits on the curve

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 0 line 3 'The notes you just wrote' is the closest: antecedent is write-your-team-notes, which see-your-team.md:38 includes directly before this lecture (module-arc carve-out). Chunk 4 line 36 'this ladder' resolves to the four steps in the same chunk; chunk 3 line 25 'the two' resolves to theory and your people in line 23. Harm (unresolvable referent) absent.
No cross-file pointer by position; line 3 names the notes by what they are, and 'the notes you just wrote' is a lived-module beat, not a positional file callback. Harm absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 3 'The notes you just wrote' and line 19 'You wrote some of it down a few minutes ago' both resolve: exercises/write-your-team-notes.md exists (ls curriculum/exercises) and is included at see-your-team.md:38 immediately before this lecture at :40.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal or live-demo beat; no prompt blocks

rules_evaluated.evidence: Thinnest chunk is chunk 2 'You bring your people' (lines 15-19): a self-carrying claim (your knowledge of people is what no framework or research carries). Not a wait-state.

Closest: chunk 4 'Where the team sits on the curve' (line 27) over four steps of engineering agent adoption; content states where teams sit on the ladder and that the spread is what gets put on the page (line 38). Header does not contradict content. Chunk 1 'We bring the lenses' lines 5-13 lists three lenses as promised.

Chunk 2 line 17 'Who trusts whom. Who teaches quietly... Who came out of the last reorg... Who is the best engineer...' is the nearest anaphora run but each leg carries new concrete content (rule: third leg new content). Line 19 'No framework carries that, and no research does either' is a single declarative, no Not-X-Not-Y-Z. Line 13 'These are lenses, not a plan.' is one contrast, not the banned triple. No superlatives, no number+retraction, no empty verb triplet; line 25 'It multiplies what you bring. It replaces neither half.' is a pair.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep of maintainer dialect (beat, mood, compendium, surface-as-noun, firing) in body_numbered: none; 'lenses' and 'ladder' are ordinary register for engineering leaders. Closest: line 34 'Compounding engineering' is the spine's named step, arc vocabulary, not repo dialect. Harm (room cannot parse) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 4 lines 31-34 carry four bolded step names and chunk 1 lines 9-11 three bolded lens names. Each is a coined-term/checklist-item handle of 1-2 words, never a sentence, and each slide is an enumeration of named items (one handle per named item, the law/consolidation allowance). No bold on narrative prose.
